value.rationale: A complete generalized Hamming-weight hierarchy is a canonical structural invariant, strictly richer than ordinary minimum distance and directly relevant to the recent projective-extremal program. The code is not an arbitrary small example: it is the unique optimal \([23,14,5]_2\) Wagner class, while its dual is a natural 9-dimensional object adjacent to the first dimension not covered by the recent exact tables. Computing all nine thresholds therefore gives a reusable exact benchmark rather than a routine parameter perturbation.
